The revised decision tree now separates CLIP influence from failure relevance and direction, handles every A1/A2-A5 outcome without attributing zero-CLIP effects specifically to arithmetic mean, defines and bounds the observed-source factorial, preserves samples_z provenance, and keeps all latent/Plucker permutations as non-ranking OOD correspondence stresses. No new internal contradiction was found.

focal_regression_checks.evidence: Line 83 limits the claim to the released checkpoint/interface and absence of released K/V-greater-than-one adaptation evidence; multi-token sequence remains an unvalidated, likely OOD structural intervention rather than a claimed training fact.

Lines 70-76 retain A2 nearest, A3 farthest, A4 medoid, and A5 Surfel-vote mean and explicitly forbid skipping A4/A5 after A2/A3 failure. Line 72 distinguishes frozen-pool/interface/budget fairness from different delivered information.

Lines 89-104 define an observed-source, geometry-stable image counterfactual; line 91 separates VAE-encoded observed latents from generated samples_z and makes generated-source delta transfer a stress; lines 97-102 correctly distinguish the four cells and coherent versus conflicting conditions.

Lines 126-132 place all three outside A0-A5, require fixed permutations and mask retention, update both duplicated Plucker paths and c/uc consistently, identify broken frame-camera/time relations, and prohibit same-information or path-dominance claims.

internal_consistency_checks.finding: Gate 0 establishes a real, traced natural failure; Gate 1 first tests path influence and failure relevance; Gate 2 tests all ordinary one-token aggregation explanations; Section 6 is entered only for a bounded consumer diagnostic.
The report never treats A1 alone as evidence against arithmetic averaging and preserves the alternative explanations of encoder granularity and the entire global crossattn condition.

The report acknowledges F10/F01 conflict, makes F11 coherent, requires repeated low-intensity interventions, fixes all unrelated conditions, and defines both scalar and spatial interactions before evaluation.
Appearance counterfactuals are required to preserve geometry and M_i validity; Plucker changes are reserved for separate OOD binding stresses and cannot be ranked against appearance paths.

The final verdict remains a protocol-level Reject-and-Pivot for ordinary methods and Accept-with-Revisions for the diagnostic question, while explicitly reporting zero model loads, zero real videos, and zero improvements.

pass_boundary: PASS certifies only the internal consistency and evidence discipline of this frozen report version. It does not certify model availability, experiment execution, a real VMem failure, causal effects, method novelty, or publication-level contribution.
